outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 1,778 singletons born to primiparous women aged 25-40 years after IVF and 33,555 singletons born to primiparous women of the same age range after spontaneous conception in Estonia from 2005-2014
finding: Compared to spontaneous conception, IVF singletons in Estonia had a higher risk of preterm birth, iatrogenic preterm birth, very preterm birth, low birth weight, congenital anomalies, NICU admission, placenta previa, placental abruption, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section risk was higher in the IVF cohort compared to the spontaneous conception cohort.
birth_weight: Lower in the IVF cohort compared to the spontaneous conception cohort
